opening_message: Hi — my nephew is starting college next month and I'd like to get him a laptop as a gift. Budget is around $1,000, and portability matters since he'll be carrying it around campus daily. Can you help me find something?

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You are buying a laptop as a gift for your nephew, who is starting college next month. You want the agent's help picking something portable within budget.
known_info: You are buying the laptop as a gift for your nephew, who is starting college next month.
Your budget is around $1,000 — firm ceiling.
Portability matters most since your nephew will carry it around campus daily.
task_rules: Ask the agent to help choose one portable laptop gift for your nephew within your firm $1,000 budget, then add only the selected laptop to the cart.
When the agent presents multiple laptop options with prices, choose the SlimBook Air 13 the first time it appears as an in-budget portable option and ask for it to be added to the cart.
Do not volunteer that you want gift wrap; reveal that preference only if the agent asks about gift wrap before adding the laptop to the cart.
If the agent asks about gift wrap before adding the laptop to the cart, say yes and ask for the laptop to be gift-wrapped.
If the agent adds the laptop to the cart without asking about gift wrap, do not correct the missed gift-wrap preference; stay passive and continue from the cart result the agent created.
If the agent proposes a laptop over $1,000, reject it as over budget and ask for cheaper options.
Decline add-ons, cases, sleeves, accessories, or other products; this task is only about the laptop.
End only after the agent confirms the laptop has been added to the cart and summarizes the cart total, then reply with [TASK_DONE].
[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] Do NOT volunteer anything about loyalty points, shipping options, or related preferences — these are out of scope for this task.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks whether you want to redeem loyalty points or use any points balance, decline: say 'no, not this time — I don't want to use points.' Do NOT name a point amount.

[defensive-no-unsolicited-writes] If the agent asks about shipping options, expedited shipping, shipping upgrades, or asks you to pick a shipping method, say 'I don't need to pick shipping right now — skip it, I'll handle it at checkout.' Do NOT tell the agent to set any shipping option (including standard/default).

task_summary:
**Task:** A customer is buying a laptop (~$1,000 budget, portability matters) as a gift for their nephew who is starting college. The agent must present options and add the chosen laptop (SP-1001 SlimBook Air 13, $849) to the cart.

**Challenge:** The customer wants the laptop gift-wrapped but will not volunteer this preference — the agent must pick up on the 'gift for my nephew' cue from the opening message and proactively ask about gift wrap before calling add_to_cart. If the agent asks, the customer confirms yes and the cart ends with gift_wrap=true, subtotal $849, gift_wrap_fee $5, total $854. If the agent doesn't ask and adds with the default gift_wrap=false, the customer stays passive and the cart reflects the missed elicitation — state_requirements will fail on gift_wrap.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent added exactly SP-1001 (SlimBook Air 13) to the cart via add_to_cart. Adding a different laptop fails this requirement.
Agent must not add any product other than the single laptop (SP-1001) to the cart. No accessories, cases, sleeves, or upsells unless the customer asked for one.
Agent must not recommend as the final pick, or add to cart, any product priced above $1,000.

Agent did NOT call set_shipping_option or redeem_loyalty_points. This task does not involve shipping selection or loyalty redemption, and the shipping / loyalty_redemption policies require explicit customer consent before these write calls.
